questions.explanation: 수동태의 올바른 문법 구조를 가진 모든 문장을 선택하는 문제로, 각 문장의 문법적 정확성을 종합적으로 판단해야 합니다.

options: ① This road does not use much by the villagers.
② When did antibiotics discovered?
③ In Korea, elections for president are held every 5 years.
④ Sometimes it's quite noisy living here, but it's not a problem for me. I am bothered not by it.
⑤ How is mountains formed?
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
questions.explanation: ③번이 올바르다. ①은 'is not used', ②는 'were discovered', ④는 'I am not bothered by it', ⑤는 'are mountains formed'가 되어야 한다.

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장을 모두 골라 짝지은 것은?
ⓐ Leonardo da Vinci painted the Mona Lisa.
ⓑ Hangeul was made by King Sejong the Great.
ⓒ Romeo and Juliet wrote Shakespeare.
ⓓ The light bulb invented by Edison.
ⓔ The Starry Night is painted by van Gogh.
questions.explanation: ⓐ, ⓑ, ⓔ가 올바르다. ⓒ는 'Romeo and Juliet was written by Shakespeare', ⓓ는 'The light bulb was invented by Edison'이 되어야 한다.

(b) The bike is fixed not in the store.
(c) He will be invited to my wedding yesterday.
(d) He was taken to a hospital by them.
(e) Her purse was stolen last night.
questions.explanation: (a) 'Was the meeting held', (b) 'is not fixed', (c) 시제 불일치 오류가 있어 3개의 문장에 오류가 있습니다.

(d) The library in the town built in 1897.

questions.explanation: (e)만이 올바른 수동태 구조를 가지고 있으며, 나머지는 모두 동사 형태나 구조상 오류가 있습니다.

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
• I was waken by a loud noise.
• The mouse was cought by a cat.
• The cat was carried away by a dog.
• The white dress was made of Andre Kim.
• The Eiffel Tower was build by Alexandre Gustave Eiffel.
• The Old Man and the Sea was written by Ernest Hemingway.
questions.explanation: 'was carried away'와 'was written by'만이 올바른 수동태 형태이며, 나머지는 과거분사 오류나 전치사 오류가 있습니다.

questions.question:
Choose the sentences which are grammatically incorrect.
(A) The roof was covered with snow.
(B) By whom was America discovered?
(C) The kites fly in the field by children yesterday.
(D) The room cleaned by him.
(E) A letter should be sent to her by Mr. Smith.
(F) The movie is loved by many people last year.
questions.explanation: (C)와 (F)는 수동태 구조가 잘못되었고, (D)는 be동사가 누락된 문법 오류가 있습니다.

questions.question:
다음 능동태 문장을 수동태로 전환했을 때 가장 적절한 것은?
① The students read the book.
→ The book was reading by the students.
② My sister planted the tree.
→ The tree is planted by my sister.
③ Jimin wrote the story yesterday.
→ The story was wrote by Jimin yesterday.
④ Anna invited Tom to her birthday party.
→ Tom was invited by Anna to her birthday party.
⑤ Jane will wash the dishes after work.
→ The dishes will washed by Jane after work.
questions.explanation: ④번만이 올바른 수동태 전환으로, 'Tom was invited to her birthday party by Anna'가 정확한 구조입니다.

questions.question:
다음 능동태 문장을 수동태로 전환했을 때 가장 적절한 것은?
① Dave took the picture.
→ The picture was took by Dave.
② My mom baked these cookies.
→ These cookies was baked by my mom.
③ King Sejong invented Hangeul.
→ Hangeul was invented by King Sejong.
④ Shakespeare wrote Romeo and Juliet.
→ Romeo and Juliet were written by Shakespeare.
⑤ Lisa invited us to her birthday party.
→ Her birthday party was invited us by Lisa.
questions.explanation: ③번이 정답으로 'Hangeul was invented by King Sejong'은 과거 수동태의 올바른 형태입니다.

questions.question:
다음 능동태 문장을 수동태로 전환했을 때 가장 적절한 것은?
① Everyone in this city knows him.
→ He is known to everyone in this city.
② Yuri will invite the boy to her birthday party.
→ Her birthday party will be invited to the boy.
③ Korean history interests me.
→ I am interested by Korean history.
④ Smoke filled the room.
→ The room is filled with smoke.
⑤ We will always love our children.
→ Our children are always loved by us.
questions.explanation: ①번 'He is known to everyone'이 올바른 수동태 전환으로, 'know' 동사의 특별한 수동태 구조입니다.

questions.question:
다음 중 수동태로 바르게 전환한 것이 아닌 것을 모두 고르면?
① What do they call this in English?
→ What is this called in English?
② Judy can teach us music.
→ Music can taught to us by Judy.
③ We painted our house green.
→ Our house was painted green by us.
④ Did Brian solve the puzzle?
→ Was the puzzle solved by Brian?
⑤ The police captured the pickpocket.
→ The pickpocket has captured by the police.
questions.explanation: ②번은 'can be taught', ⑤번은 'was captured'가 되어야 하므로 두 문장 모두 수동태 전환에 오류가 있습니다.

questions.question:
다음 중 수동태로 전환한 문장이 어색한 것을 모두 고르면?
① The bad boy laughed at me.
→ I was laughed at the bad boy.
② Sally gave me a cute doll.
→ A cute doll was given to me by Sally.
③ He must finish the work in time.
→ The work must be finished in time by him.
④ Do plenty of people speak Chinese?
→ Is Chinese spoken by plenty of people?
⑤ Scientists are discovering new animals and plants.
→ New animals and plants are being discovering by scientist.
questions.explanation: ①번은 'I was laughed at by the bad boy', ⑤번은 'are being discovered'가 되어야 올바른 수동태입니다.

questions.question:
다음 중 능동태를 수동태로 전환한 문장이 어색한 것을 모두 고르면?
① She took care of her baby.
→ Her baby was taken care of her.
② The news surprised her.
→ She was surprised at the news.
③ They will build a new school.
→ A new school will be build by them.
④ Jack gave me these books.
→ These books were given to me by Jack.
⑤ Where did he buy the hat?
→ Where was the hat bought by him?
questions.explanation: ①번은 'by her' 삭제, ③번은 'will be built'가 되어야 하므로 두 문장에 수동태 전환 오류가 있습니다.

questions.question:
다음 능동태 문장을 수동태로 전환했을 때 가장 적절한 것은?
① My dad will build a house.
→ A house will built by my dad.
② He broke the cup.
→ The cup was broken by him.
③ I found the wallet.
→ The wallet was found by me.
④ My mom cooks dinner.
→ Dinner was cooked by my mom.
⑤ Marc Chagall painted I and the Village.
→ I and the Village were painted by Marc Chagall.
questions.explanation: ②번과 ③번이 모두 올바른 수동태 전환으로, 과거 능동태를 과거 수동태로 정확히 변환했습니다.

questions.question:
다음 능동태 문장을 수동태로 전환했을 때 가장 적절한 것은?
① Ms. Kim loved Hyun Bin.
→ Hyun Bin is loved by Ms. Kim.
② Shakespeare wrote this book.
→ This book was written by Shakespeare.
③ The carpenters make the house.
→ The house was made by the carpenters.
④ The police did not find the robbers.
→ The robbers are not found by the police.
⑤ My little brother breaks the window.
→ The window was broken by my little brother.
questions.explanation: ②번만이 올바른 수동태 전환으로, 과거 시제를 일치시켜 'was written'을 정확히 사용했습니다.

questions.question:
다음 능동태 문장을 수동태로 전환했을 때 가장 적절한 것은?
① I make an airplane.
→ An airplane is maded from me.
② He grows some plants.
→ Some plants are growing by him.
③ She didn't open it.
→ It didn't be opened by her.
④ They broke the window.
→ The window was broken by them.
⑤ Min-su invited John to the party.
→ Min-su was invited to the party by John.
questions.explanation: ④번만이 올바른 수동태 전환으로, 'The window was broken by them'이 정확한 과거 수동태 구조입니다.

questions.question:
다음 수동태 문장을 능동태로 전환했을 때 어색한 것은?
① Sora was invited to the party by John.
→ John invited Sora to the party.
② The mirror was broken by Tom.
→ Tom broken the mirror.
③ These cookies were made by Mike.
→ Mike made these cookies.
④ Our house was built by my grandfather.
→ My grandfather built our house.
⑤ Computers are used by many people.
→ Many people use computers.
questions.explanation: ②번은 'Tom broke the mirror'가 되어야 하는데, 'broken'으로 잘못 표기되어 능동태 전환이 어색합니다.

questions.question:
다음 능동태 문장을 수동태로 전환했을 때 어색한 것은?
① We see the moon at night.
→ The moon is seen at night by us.
② John made the delicious cheese cake.
→ The delicious cheese cake was made by John.
③ My father gave me a present.
→ I was given a present by my father.
④ You must not leave the door open.
→ The door must not left open.
⑤ Mr. Park built this beautiful house.
→ This beautiful house was built by Mr. Park.
questions.explanation: ④번이 어색합니다. 조동사가 포함된 수동태는 'must not be left'가 되어야 하는데, be동사가 빠져있습니다. 조동사 + be + 과거분사 형태를 지켜야 합니다.

questions.question:
다음 능동태 문장을 수동태로 전환했을 때 어색한 것은?
① Tom broke the window.
→ The window was broken by Tom.
② Children love the story Cinderella
→ The story Cinderella is loved by children.
③ Mom gave me some old pictures.
→ Some old pictures were given to me by mom.
④ The police caught the thieves.
→ The thieves was caught by the police.
⑤ An old woman bought the book.
→ The book was bought by an old woman.
questions.explanation: ④번이 어색합니다. 주어 'The thieves'는 복수형이므로 be동사는 'were'를 사용해야 하는데, 'was'가 잘못 사용되었습니다. 주어와 동사의 수일치를 맞춰야 합니다.

questions.question:
다음 능동태 문장을 수동태로 전환했을 때 어색한 것은?
① He didn't pay the bill.
→ The bill wasn't paid by him.
② My brother broke the chair.
→ The chair was broken by my brother.
③ I took this photo last night.
→ This photo was taken last night by me.
④ My sister wore the skirt.
→ The skirt was worn by my sister.
⑤ She sold two hats at the flea market.
→ The flea market was sold by her two hats at.
questions.explanation: ⑤번이 어색합니다. 능동태에서 목적어가 'two hats'이므로 수동태의 주어도 'Two hats were sold'가 되어야 합니다. 전체 문장 구조가 잘못되어 어순이 뒤바뀌었습니다.

questions.question:
다음 능동태 문장을 수동태로 전환했을 때 어색한 것은?
① J.K Rowling wrote 'Harry Potter.'
→ 'Harry Potter' was written by J.K. Rowling.
② She drew the pictures.
→ The pictures were drawn by her.
③ We called her Little Kim Yeona.
→ Little Kim Yeona was called by us.
④ Beatles sang 'Yesterday.'
→ 'Yesterday' was sung by Beatles.
⑤ The best teacher teaches us English.
→ We are taught English by the best teacher.
questions.explanation: ③번이 어색합니다. 'call A B'(A를 B라고 부르다) 구문에서 수동태는 'She was called Little Kim Yeona by us'가 되어야 합니다. 목적격 보어를 포함한 5형식 문장의 수동태 전환 규칙을 따라야 합니다.

questions.question:
Which of the following does NOT have the closest meaning to each other?
① I take care of the baby.
= The baby is taken care of me.
② An artist painted the picture in 1889.
= The picture was painted in 1889.
③ They speak English in Canada.
= English is spoken in Canada.
④ Your son broke my kitchen window.
= My kitchen window was broken by your son.
⑤ The fire destroyed my house.
= My house was destroyed by the fire.
questions.explanation: ①번이 의미가 다릅니다. 'take care of'는 구동사이므로 수동태에서 전치사를 유지해야 하며, 'The baby is taken care of by me'가 올바른 형태입니다. 구동사의 수동태에서는 전치사를 분리하면 안 됩니다.

options: Jessica took these photos. → These photos were taken by Jessica.
They didn't break the windows. → The windows were not broken by them.
The secretary writes all the letters. → All the letters are written by the secretary.
Judy will play the piano. → The piano will be played by Judy.
A French family found the missing child. → The missing child was founded by a French family.
questions.question: 다음 능동태 문장을 수동태로 전환했을 때 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: ⑤ find의 과거분사는 'found'인데 'founded'(설립하다)로 잘못 써서 어색하다. 나머지는 올바른 수동태 전환이다.

options: He delivered the box. = The box was delivered by him.
Did Junsu finish the work? = Was the work finished by Junsu?
They built a beautiful house last year. = A beautiful house was built by them last year.
He will bring the cart tomorrow. = The cart will be brought by him tomorrow.
He may forget her name. = Her name was forgotten by him.
questions.question: Which of the following does NOT have the same meaning to each other?
questions.explanation: ⑤ 'may forget'(현재·미래 추측)을 'was forgotten'(과거)으로 바꿔 시제·의미가 달라졌다. 나머지는 능동·수동 의미가 같다.

options: David accepted his proposal. = His proposal was accepted by David.
Minho moved his chair. = His chair was moved by Minho.
Did she check the e-mail? = Was the e-mail checked by her?
My uncle doesn't grow trees. = Trees weren't grow by my uncle.
He will bring the book tomorrow. = The book will be brought by him tomorrow.
questions.question: Which of the following is not correct conversion from the active to the passive voice?
questions.explanation: ④ grow의 과거분사는 'grown'인데 'weren't grow'로 잘못 써서 어색하다. 나머지는 올바른 수동태 전환이다.

options: They don't like him. → He is not liked by them.
I saw her dance in the room. → She was seen to dance in the room by me.
I have finished the homework. → The homework has been finished by me.
We are making a big kite. → A big kite is being made by us.
We called him Jack. → Jack was called him by us.
questions.question: 다음 중 수동태의 전환이 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: ⑤ 'call O C'(5형식)의 수동태는 'He was called Jack by us'인데 'Jack was called him'으로 잘못 전환되어 어색하다.

options: She takes care of the children. → The children is taken care of by her.
People speak English in New Zealand. → English is spoken in New Zealand.
We elected him our president. → Our president was elected him by us.
She teaches us English. → English is taught for us by her.
My little brother broke the window. → The window was broken by my little brother.
questions.question: 다음 중 능동태 문장을 수동태로 바르게 바꾼 것은?
questions.explanation: 능동태를 수동태로 바르게 바꾼 것은 ② 'English is spoken in New Zealand.'와 ⑤ 'The window was broken by my little brother.'이다.

options: (the cookies, baked, Jane) → The cookies were baked by Jane.

questions.question: 다음 <보기>와 같이 괄호 안의 말을 담아들 이용하여 문장을 완성할 때 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: ③ stop의 과거분사는 'stopped'인데 'was stop'으로 써서 어색하다. 나머지는 올바른 수동태 문장이다.
